name: Closing a period shows its summary and stores a snapshot
title: SC-07-12-01 Closing a period shows its summary and stores a snapshot
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given period "2026-10" is open with 16800.00 accrued and 14000.00 collected
When the manager closes period "2026-10"
Then the summary shows accrued 16800.00, collected 14000.00 and outstanding 2800.00
And the period status is CLOSED
